name: LoyaltyMemberConsole
tagline: Members, tiers, points, vouchers and approvals – the loyalty desk for stores, hotels and restaurants in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete loyalty console on your own points ledger: find or enrol members, see balances, tiers and progress to the next tier, earn on spend with tier multipliers, redeem points, issue reward vouchers, make goodwill and correction adjustments with approval limits and segregation of duties, run FIFO points expiry and track issued vs redeemed points, the points liability and expiring points. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Member lookup and enrolment with consent and duplicate checks
Tiers from qualifying points in a rolling window, multipliers and progress to the next tier
Points ledger with running balances and available points
Earn on spend with duplicate-receipt check
Goodwill and corrections with associate / supervisor / manager limits
Segregation of duties – nobody approves their own request
Redemptions and reward vouchers with codes, validity and Mark used
FIFO points expiry with expiring-soon and expiry-due
Liability at the point value, issued vs redeemed, redemption rate
Bulk approve / reject / reverse, undo, CSV export
Power Fx outputs and events (SummaryJson, StatementText)
